phrase.zh: 在建造之前，先想象如何生活。
phrase.en: Before building, imagine how life could unfold.

visual.zh: 绘图的手、弧线和展开的建筑空间，把构想与建造之间的距离呈现出来。它不是可施工的图纸，不提供结构安全、尺寸或造价承诺。
visual.en: A drafting hand, arcs and unfolding spaces show the distance between imagining and building. This is not a construction drawing and makes no structural, dimensional or cost claims.

background.zh: MoMA 收藏的富勒 Dymaxion House 方案平面图定年为 1927—1929 年，展示建筑如何通过图纸探索不同的组织方式。馆藏中“方案”与“建成物”需要区分；未建成的设计也能记录一个时代对技术与生活的设想。
background.en: MoMA dates Fuller’s Dymaxion House project plan to 1927–1929. It shows drawings exploring ways to organize architecture. A project is distinct from a completed building; unbuilt designs can still record an era’s ideas about technology and living.
